verdict.rationale: Insomnia is a desktop and cloud API-client platform with a CLI and cloud services, so asking whether it offers versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack has no documented versioned public API and no deprecation policy, and probes for an OpenAPI description all returned 404. Versioned import/export file formats (Insomnia JSON v4, YAML v5) are data formats, not a versioned API with a deprecation commitment.
